title: feat(kernel): Dev Mode Plugin Protocol + full-service @objectstack/plugin-dev
body:
- [x] Protocol schema (`dev-plugin.zod.ts`) — 19 tests
- [x] Plugin implementation with 8 real service plugins
- [x] Code review feedback addressed
- [x] **ALL 17+ kernel services with contract-compliant stubs:**
  - **Real plugins** (8): ObjectQL, InMemoryDriver, AppPlugin, Auth, Security, Hono Server, REST API, Dispatcher
  - **Contract-compliant dev stubs** implementing interfaces from `packages/spec/src/contracts/`:
    - `cache` (Map-backed ICacheService), `queue` (in-memory IQueueService), `job` (IJobService), `file-storage` (IStorageService), `search` (ISearchService), `automation` (IAutomationService), `graphql` (IGraphQLService), `analytics` (IAnalyticsService), `realtime` (IRealtimeService), `notification` (INotificationService), `ai` (IAIService), `i18n` (II18nService), `ui` (IUIService), `workflow` (IWorkflowService), `metadata` (IMetadataService), `data` (IDataEngine), `auth` (IAuthService), `security.*` (permissions/RLS/masking)
- [x] Tests: 19 schema tests + 7 plugin tests with per-service contract assertions
- [x] Code review + CodeQL — no alerts
